Introduction
This document sets out the test steps that must be carried out annually. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station "El-Walidia", 2*300 MW, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the test was carried out on 18 October 2002 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the test crew must carry the industrial safety category card
Fence off the work area and place the warning signs.
The unit is out of service
Wear occupational safety and health equipment
Verify that the device to be tested is as stated on the Name Plate
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Helmet and safety shoes
Current injection set, type PHU 100
Voltage injection set, type PHU 100
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA
Helmet and safety shoes
Current injection set, type PHU 100
Voltage injection set, type PHU 100
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, type YOGOGAWA
Millisecond counter type MCS 5 N (Timer)
Test comb type RTXH 18, test leads used
Procedures to be Carried Out
Verify that the unit is out of service | 1.
Verify that the device to be tested is as stated on the Name Plate | 2.
Place the test comb, test plug type RTXH18, in Test socket type RTXP18 of the relay | 3.
Inject current at points 3,4 in the test comb RTXH 18 for phase R and fix its value at 5 amp | 4.
Inject voltage at points 9,12 in the test comb RTXH 18 for phase R, of value 110 volts | 5.
Set the angle between current and voltage to zero | 6.
Reduce the voltage gradually until the first stage signal appears | 7.
Record the voltage reading for the first stage | 8.
Reduce the voltage gradually until the second stage signal appears | 9.
Record the voltage reading for the second stage | 10.
Raise the voltage to 110 volts | 11.
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points 16,18 in the test comb RTXH 18 | 12.
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to points T1,T2 in the PHU-100 voltage injection set | 13.
Disconnect the voltage injection set | 14.
Record the time readings for the first stage | 15.
Raise the voltage to 110 volts | 16.
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points 17,18 in the test comb RTXH 18 | 17.
Reset the timer | 18.
Disconnect the voltage injection set | 19.
Record the time reading for the second stage | 20.
Inject current at points 5,6 in the test comb RTXH 18 for phase S and fix its value at 5 amp | 21.
Inject voltage at points 10,12 in the test comb RTXH 18 for phase S, of value 110 volts | 22.
Set the angle between current and voltage to zero | 23.
Reduce the voltage gradually until the first stage signal appears | 24.
Record the voltage reading for the first stage | 25.
Reduce the voltage gradually until the second stage signal appears | 26.
Record the voltage reading for the second stage | 27.
Inject current at points 7,8 in the test comb RTXH 18 for phase T and fix its value at 5 amp | 28.
Inject voltage at points 11,12 in the test comb RTXH 18 for phase T, of value 110 volts | 29.
Set the angle between current and voltage to zero | 30.
Reduce the voltage gradually until the first stage signal appears | 31.
Record the voltage reading for the first stage | 32.
Reduce the voltage gradually until the second stage signal appears | 33.
Record the voltage reading for the second stage | 34.
Disconnect the voltage injection set | 35.
Remove the test comb, test plug type RTXH18, from Test socket type RTXP18 at the relay (a21Ga) | 36.
